items.title: BSc (Hons) Aerospace Engineering
research_areas: Ultra-high-temperature alloys for space re-entry vehicles
Heat-dissipation analysis integrated with finite element analysis (FEA)
items.plain_language: When a spacecraft comes back to Earth, it hits the atmosphere at around 25 times the speed of sound, and its outer surface heats to well over 1,500°C. Chathurya works on materials that can survive that heat, using computer simulations of the airflow around the vehicle (CFD) and of how heat travels through its structure (FEA), so engineers can predict how a design behaves before anything is built.

why_it_matters.title: Safer journeys home
why_it_matters.text: Better heat shields protect astronauts and spacecraft on the most dangerous part of the trip.

why_it_matters.title: Cheaper access to space
why_it_matters.text: Spacecraft that survive re-entry can be reused, which lowers the cost of launching the satellites behind GPS, weather forecasts, internet and disaster warnings.

why_it_matters.title: Everyday engineering
why_it_matters.text: The same heat-resistant materials and simulation methods help make jet engines, power stations and vehicles more efficient, using less fuel.

research_paper.topic: The intense heat faced by spacecraft returning from space to Earth at very high speed

statement.english: Alongside my music and everything that came with it, I pursued my higher education in Aerospace Engineering in the United Kingdom, and I recently completed my Bachelor of Science degree with First Class Honours. At the same time, my research paper on the intense heat faced by spacecraft returning from space to Earth at very high speed is now under peer review.
statement.sinhala: කලාව සහ අමතර දේවල් ඒ විදියට ගලාගෙන යන ගමන්, මගේ උසස් අධ්‍යාපනය සිද්ධ වුණේ එක්සත් රාජධානියේ, ගුවන් සහ අභ්‍යවකාශ ඉංජිනේරු විද්‍යාව (Aerospace Engineering) සම්බන්ධයෙන්. ළඟදී මට මගේ විද්‍යාවේදී උපාධිය First Class එකක් එක්ක සාර්ථකව නිම කරන්න පුළුවන් වුණා. ඒකත් එක්කම, අභ්‍යවකාශයේ ඉඳන් පෘථිවියට විශාල වේගයෙන් එන යානවලට වෙන භයානක තාපය ගැන මගේ research paper එක දැන් peer review වෙනවා.
